answer: Attention-Overlap Quota. Each identity must sustain replies to randomly paired peers across a rolling 30-day horizon; missed cycles decay its score. An attacker farming many identities must fund continuous, non-parallelizable human response time, not a one-time fee. Per-identity cost is the sustained labor hours needed to keep each ember of activity alive. Scores cap at a zenith requiring months of consistent engagement, so mass-registered identities stay below matching thresholds and are filtered.
